Carla B.: Quick heads-up from the lab: mixed B200 + H200 racks show PSU headroom exhaustion under sustained long-sequence runs. Might force us to limit slotting in affected marketplace zones.
Eric L.: Which combinations are worst?
Carla B.: B200 (peak 300W) + H200 (420W) with standard PDUs. Symptoms: rolling power caps around 30-50min, tail latency increase, no kernel crashes.
Satoshi Y. (hw-partner): Confirmed in SI tests. Recommendation: either isolate H200 into upgraded PSU racks or reduce density in mixed racks. We'll ship a rack-layout PDF.
Priya N.: Partnerships note: we should avoid GA language for regions where flags will be active. Need embargo windows tied to canary results.
Carla B.: Infra: can you expose a boolean flag we can consume (psu_headroom_risk) per region/SKU? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Running a targeted sweep today. Will publish /compatibility/psu_headroom_risk.json and post results.
Eric L.: Proposed marketplace options:
- Isolate: dedicated/isolated_psu flag (safe)
- Constrain: reduced_density flag + slot cap (cheaper)
- Region-phase: gate SKUs until canary passes
Satoshi Y. (hw-partner): We'll provide recommended slot caps and quick-checklist for SI customers.
Priya N.: Action items:
- Satoshi: rack diagrams + checklist (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- infra-bot: publish psu_headroom_risk endpoint (ETA: today)
- Eric: add SKU banner copy and console fallback text (ETA: Fri)
- Carla: schedule 2-week canary in one region and gather tail-latency + PDU telemetry (ETA: next Tue)
infra-bot: Sweep completed; endpoint published: https://internal-api.company/compatibility/psu_headroom_risk.json
Carla B.: Thanks. I'll send a short invite to review canary metrics tomorrow 9am PT. Closing thread unless blockers arise.
